newsitem.title: USA: YURIE IN MARKETING PACT WITH LUCENT.
newsitem.headline: YURIE IN MARKETING PACT WITH LUCENT.

text.p: Yurie Systems Inc said it reached a three-year agreement with Lucent Technologies Inc under which Lucent will market certain Yurie networking products under the Lucent brand.
Yurie, a maker of asynchronous transfer mode networking products, did not disclose terms of the agreement but said the pact could make Lucent its largest customer.

In a statement, Harry Carr, Yurie's president and chief operating officer said Lucent had no minimum purchase obligation under the deal but added, "With the successful execution of the companies' plans over the next three years, Yurie projects that Lucent will become our largest customer."

During the first half of 1997, Yurie Systems posted net income of $2.6 million or $0.10 per share on $19.3 million in revenues. Lucent, the telecommunications systems company that was carved out of AT&T Corp, had fiscal third quarter revenues of $6.34 billion.
Shares in Yurie Systems jumped 4-7/8 to 28-3/8, making the company the top net gainer on Nasdaq in late morning activity.
